Commentary.Commentary: That is it then from this game and the three-game ODI series is deadlocked at 1-1. The deciding game will be played on Tuesday, the 1st of August at the Brian Lara Stadium in Tarouba, Trinidad. That match will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) but our build-up as always will begin a lot sooner. Do join us then. Take care and goodbye!

Shai Hope is the Player of the Match for his unbeaten knock of 63 runs from 80 balls, guiding West Indies to victory. He starts by saying that irrespective of his score, he is happy as long as the team wins. Shares that when it is difficult to score, it is important to run hard. Mentions that he is very satisfied with this win. States that they will come hard again and look to get over the line in the next game as well. Reckons that they showed good attitude in the field. Reckons that it was a challenging surface with the bat and they need to replicate the same attitude and effort.

Hardik Pandya, the stand-in skipper of India, says that they did not bat the way they were supposed to. Adds that this was a much better wicket. Mentions that barring Shubman Gill, everyone found the fielder perfectly. Shares that it was a good opening stand. Feels that Ishan Kishan and Shardul Thakur were the two positives from this game. Informs that his body is fine and needs to bowl more overs to get ready for the ODI World Cup. Ends by saying that a 1-1 scoreline brings out the character out of everyone.
The Presentation ceremony...

West Indies skipper Shai Hope won a crucial toss and decided to bowl first given the overcast conditions and chances of rain throughout the game. This decision didn't bear fruit until they got their first wicket with India's score being 90 runs. From thereon though, Romario Shepherd bowled a lovely spell and the hosts managed to pick up wickets in clusters in a span of few overs. Everyone contributed with wickets apart from Kyle Mayers with Gudakesh Motie and Romario Shepherd ending with three each. For India, Ishan Kishan scored yet another half-century on this tour and Shubman Gill too looked good till he got out but after that, the middle order totally crumbled and they somehow managed to get to the 180-run mark. In reply, with the game hanging in the balance, Shai Hope and Keacy Carty put on an unbeaten stand of 91 runs to take their side to victory.

India rested a couple of their big guns in the batting department which definitely made a big difference and they had a sub-par total on the board. But their bowling attack in general also lacked a bit of bite and apart from Shardul Thakur no one really showed up as he picked up three wickets and gave his side half a chance. The pace trio of Hardik Pandya, Mukesh Kumar and Umran Malik was off-colour, and even in the spin department, only Kuldeep Yadav did a bit of damage. The ground fielding was also not up to their high standards and they will now look to bounce back strong in the series decider.

A resilient showing from the Windies skipper Shai Hope and Keacy Carty has taken their side to a first ODI win against India since 2019, breaking a run of nine successive losses and more importantly has allowed the hosts to level the series. It really was a solid all-around display from West Indies as the skipper led from the front with the bat and they will be fairly pleased with that effort. The win was set up nicely by the bowlers and the fielders and this was backed up by a fiery opening start by Kyle Mayers. However, they lost a couple of wickets in quick succession and the same happened after a few overs again. Then came the all-vital stand as skipper Shai Hope ended up with a match-winning half-century and Keacy Carty remained unbeaten on a crucial 48 as well. They will now look to build on this win and clinch the decider.

FOUR! THAT'S IT! Keacy Carty finishes things off in style for West Indies! Hardik continues to go short and just outside off, Keacy Carty backs away and thumps it with a flat bat. Gets it over extra cover and it almost went the distance. The ball falls agonizingly short of the ropes and Keacy Carty will remain unbeaten on 48. West Indies win by 6 wickets!

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks break! This game looked like a low-scoring thriller but the partnership between skipper Shai Hope and Keacy Carty has all but got the job done for West Indies. India had a great chance of making further in-roads but haven't been able to pick up wickets and the sloppy fielding hasn't helped them stem the flow of runs either. With just 34 runs needed and 6 wickets in hand, its hard to see the hosts losing this one but we have seen stranger things happen in a game of cricket.

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks break! We have got a real contest on our hands it seems as the game is on a knife's edge at the moment. West Indies got off to a solid start thanks to some sensational shot-making by Kyle Mayers but then the double blow from Shardul Thakur to get rid of both the openers in the same over pulled things back for India. Commentary.Commentary: There's that steep bounce again. Hardik Pandya hits the deck hard and bowls it outside off, Kyle Mayers throws his hands at it but is well beaten. Ishan Kishan collects the ball around his head.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Hardik Pandya to Kyle Mayers, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Perfect length, in the channel around off and this one just holds its line. Brandon King looks to block off the front foot but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Mukesh Kumar to Brandon King, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length around off and middle, Brandon King watchfully nudges it toward mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Mukesh Kumar to Brandon King, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and outside off, Kyle Mayers plays yet another good-looking cover drive wide of extra cover. Hardik Pandya does well to dive to his right and get a hand on it. Sanju Samson chases it down as the batters pick up three runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Mukesh Kumar to Kyle Mayers, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, really close to the off stump and going straight through. Kyle Mayers makes an assured leave.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Mukesh Kumar to Kyle Mayers, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Kyle Mayers looks to be in the zone! Pitched up wide of the off stump, Mayers gets on the front foot and thumps it away through cover for back-to-back boundaries.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Mukesh Kumar to Kyle Mayers, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Starts off with a full and straight one, a bit too straight though and Kyle Mayers flicks it off his legs through backward square leg for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Mukesh Kumar to Kyle Mayers, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Mukesh Kumar will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
A rare misfield from Ravindra Jadeja. Length ball around off, this is crunched away toward extra cover where a misfield allows Mayers to take a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Hardik Pandya to Kyle Mayers, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely bowled! Good length at 135 clicks and in that channel around off. This one goes away after pitching and Kyle Mayers does well to not get an edge on that one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Hardik Pandya to Kyle Mayers, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Wow, off the mark with a stellar shot! Pitched up around off, Kyle Mayers plants his front foot forward and stylishly punches it away through the cover region for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Hardik Pandya to Kyle Mayers, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Full and swinging down the leg side. Kyle Mayers misses the flick and a wide is called.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Hardik Pandya to Kyle Mayers, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Brandon King and West Indies are off the mark! A touch fuller around off, King plays it with soft hands down to third man for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Hardik Pandya to Brandon King, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length again, close to the off stump, Brandon King hangs back and nudges it down toward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Hardik Pandya to Brandon King, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Lovely bit of shape on that one. Starts with a good-length ball around the fifth stump line, the ball swings away and carries well to the keeper as well. Brandon King makes a leave.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Hardik Pandya to Brandon King, No run.
